dedupe_keys.name: european small reservoir pumped hydro storage atlas 36 countries

description: This atlas screens pairs of small reservoirs across 36 European countries that could serve as distributed pumped hydro storage. It was published by Robin Girard and Emanuele Quaranta with a manuscript on a continental GIS screening under drawdown and geological constraints. It gives candidate and selected non-overlapping reservoir pairs, cost-potential curves, continental summaries and sensitivity tables, varying allowable lake drawdown (0.5, 1, 2 and 5 metres), separating gross hydraulic from deliverable electrical energy, screening dry karst depressions and capping site energy at 100 MWh, 500 MWh or 1 GWh. Within 5 km of the grid the unconstrained portfolio holds 3.61 TWh of gross hydraulic energy, with a conservative technical range of about 1.9 to 2.4 TWh. Version 1.1 added installed power and head of the existing and planned European fleet from the JRC hydropower database and IHA. Coverage is 36 countries. Files are a GeoPackage and zipped tables, about 237 MB, on Zenodo (version 1.2, July 2026) under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 at no cost, with the workflow in a GitLab repository. Caveats: results are screening estimates, not plant designs, commercial use is excluded, and the README notes cross-border deduplication issues. Simulation uses are storage potential for capacity planning. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
